pages.title: Join the team
pages.description: Join Worship Connect: vocalists, musicians, sound and media. Tell us your gift and we will invite you to the next rehearsal.
pages.text: Bring your gift. We audition gently and rehearse seriously. Tell us what you do and a team leader will message you about the next rehearsal. How it works 1. Apply Send the form. The team sees it on their dashboard and replies on WhatsApp. 2. Rehearsal Come and sing or play with the team at a weekly rehearsal. 3. Serve Join the rota for Sundays, Koinonia and outreach missions. Who Members and friends of CCFC who love Jesus and can commit to rehearsals. Good to know. What people ask before they apply. Do I need professional experience? No. We audition gently and rehearse seriously. Tell us what you do, and a team leader will invite you to a rehearsal. Which roles can I apply for? Vocals, keys, guitar, bass, drums, sound and media. Do I have to be a member of CCFC? Worship Connect is for members and friends of CCFC who love Jesus and can commit to rehearsals. When do you rehearse? Every week. Ask us for the current rehearsal slot and a team leader will share it with you. What happens after I apply? The team sees your application on their dashboard and replies on WhatsApp. You come to a rehearsal, and then join the rota for Sundays, Koinonia and outreach. What languages do you sing in? English, Bemba and Nyanja, so the whole family can lift one voice. Can you sing, play or mix? Worship Connect is always growing. Vocalists, keys, guitar, bass, drums, sound and media: if God has given you a gift, bring it. Join the team Subscribe on YouTube
